description: This source file defines a React custom hook 'useExplore' that manages search queries, filtering, pagination, destination selection, and trip itinerary integration for a travel planning frontend. It leverages other hooks and services to fetch data and handle user interactions related to exploring travel destinations.

methods.name: useDebouncedValue(value, delay = 400)
methods.description: A helper hook that debounces a value by a specified delay to limit how often it updates, used here to debounce search query and filters.

methods.name: useExplore(initial = {})
methods.description: Main hook managing search state, fetching results, and providing actions such as selecting destinations and adding them to trips.
